_extra_calendars_comment: Additional audiences, and the participant arrival variants. Output paths are always unique. UIDs are unique too, EXCEPT between calendars declaring the same variant_group. A calendar client keys off uid, so a shared one makes the second file UPDATE the first in the reader's calendar rather than add a second entry. That is destructive between participant and observer, and is exactly what is wanted between the arrival times: a volunteer has one role and one arrival time, so they should hold one Exercise Horizon entry, and taking their group's file should move it rather than leave them with two events at different times. If an arrival variant is reissued after invitations have gone out, bump sequence on ALL of them together, so the new file supersedes whichever one the reader already has.

extra_calendars.name: Exercise Horizon 2026 - Observer
extra_calendars.location: Airport Experience Centre, Alpha Building, 2 George Wiencke Drive, Perth Airport WA 6105
extra_calendars.parking: Alpha Building car park at the AEC
description: Your observer place at Exercise Horizon 2026 is confirmed.
Arrive 08:00 for registration and safety briefing.
Report to: Alpha Building, 2 George Wiencke Drive, Perth Airport WA 6105 - Ground Floor, Airport Experience Centre (AEC).
Parking: Alpha Building car park at the AEC. Use gate code 1023 to enter the staff car park. Your vehicle stays there all day and you return to it at the end.
A map of the access gate, the car park and the building entrance is attached to this invitation, and is also at:
https://nicholaspagonis.github.io/Exercise-Horizon-2026/assets/email/horizon-map-alpha-building.jpg
Finish: from approximately 13:15, from the AEC.
HOW THE DAY RUNS
08:00 - Walk in to the Alpha Building, follow the signs to the AEC and sign in for registration, safety briefing, issue of hi-vis and conduct expectations.
08:30 - Board the bus and travel to the viewing area, in position before the exercise commences.
09:00 - Observe the multi-agency response from Emergency Gate 6 and other areas of the airfield.
11:30 - Move by bus to Forster Park to observe the reunification process.
12:30 - Lunch, provided at Forster Park by the Salvation Army.
13:15 - Return by bus to the AEC and are released to depart in your own vehicle.
BRING: enclosed footwear, weather appropriate clothing, sun protection (hat, sunglasses and sunscreen), water, photo identification, and any personal medication you may need.

PROVIDED: hi-vis vest and observer lanyard, registration and safety briefing on arrival, escorted bus transport for the full circuit, lunch at Forster Park by the Salvation Army, and on-site first aid support.

You remain escorted and within the monitored viewing area at all times. Follow the directions of exercise staff and airport authorised officers throughout the day. Observers are photographed and filmed during the exercise.
Reply with any dietary or allergy requirements, and let the team know as early as possible if your availability changes.
Questions: Emergency.Exercise@perthairport.com.au or 0439 237 973

description: Your reporting time for Exercise Horizon 2026 is confirmed.
MOULAGE GROUP 1 - ARRIVE 07:00 AWST
Report to Forster Park Community Centre, Forster Park, Belmont WA 6104.
Arrival times are staggered by how much moulage (injury makeup) your role needs, heaviest first. Please arrive at your allocated time and not earlier - the moulage team works to this schedule.
PARKING
Belmont Sports & Recreation Club, 400 Abernethy Rd, Cloverdale WA 6105.
Parking location: https://maps.app.goo.gl/FGvVXhEoM1re1Fv18

Full details and role descriptions: https://nicholaspagonis.github.io/Exercise-Horizon-2026

extra_calendars.name: Exercise Horizon 2026 - Family / Friend
extra_calendars.location: Forster Park Community Centre, Forster Park, Belmont WA 6104
description: Your reporting time for Exercise Horizon 2026 is confirmed.
FAMILY / FRIEND - ARRIVE 11:00 AWST
Report to Forster Park Community Centre, Forster Park, Belmont WA 6104.
You represent the loved ones arriving at the airport for news of someone on the aircraft, which is what puts the reunification process to the test. You do not go to the airfield.
PARKING
Belmont Sports & Recreation Club, 400 Abernethy Rd, Cloverdale WA 6105.
Parking location: https://maps.app.goo.gl/FGvVXhEoM1re1Fv18
Then walk north across Abernethy Road to Forster Park. The walking route is attached to this invitation, and is also at:
https://nicholaspagonis.github.io/Exercise-Horizon-2026/assets/parking-map.jpg
HOW THE DAY RUNS
Arrive at Forster Park and check in with the Volunteer Coordinators for your briefing.
You are issued a red family/friend card carrying the details you need to complete the match.
You then wait at the Survivor Reception for your matched passenger to be discharged and bussed back from the incident site.
Lunch is provided at Forster Park.
The exercise finishes at 14:00.
Each Family / Friend is matched to exactly one Patient and Passenger, so both halves need to attend. Tell the Emergency Operations team as early as possible if your availability changes.
BRING: enclosed footwear, a reusable water bottle, and any personal medication you may need.
Full details and role descriptions: https://nicholaspagonis.github.io/Exercise-Horizon-2026
Questions: Emergency.Exercise@perthairport.com.au or 0439 237 973

_card_examples_comment: Example cards embedded in the role modals, served by the card manager. These are static demonstration cards, not anybody's real allocation. embedded=true renders the card on its own without the surrounding participant page; guide=1 adds the numbered markers that the key beside each frame refers to, and does nothing unless embedded=true is set too. The key in templates/index.html is written against what these three cards render, so editing P001, P002 or F001 in the card manager can put the numbers out of step with the markers.
_downloads_comment: The key card's download buttons. `audience` limits a button to one view of the page; omit it and the button shows to everybody. The per-group calendars are not here - they are listed in the arrival times table instead, built from extra_calendars.
